name: soia-cwork-office
description: Office & content aide: read-only Feishu research with one-way sync to local Markdown, authorized ProcessOn diagram export and archiving; turns your opinions into drafts with imagery and adapts them for WeChat, Rednote and X — drafts only, never publishes.

displayDescription.en: Researches and syncs Feishu read-only, archives diagrams under your authorization, and turns your opinions into illustrated per-platform drafts — never auto-publishes.
displayDescription.zh: 只读调研并同步飞书资料、按授权归档图表；把观点写成文并配图，改写成各平台草稿，绝不自动发布。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Our team's material is spread across Feishu and ProcessOn. Research it read-only and pull a reviewable local copy.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 团队资料散在飞书和 ProcessOn 上，帮我只读调研一遍，并同步一份可复核的本地副本。

quickPrompts.en: Our team's material is spread across Feishu and ProcessOn. Research it read-only and pull a reviewable local copy.
quickPrompts.zh: 团队资料散在飞书和 ProcessOn 上，帮我只读调研一遍，并同步一份可复核的本地副本。

quickPrompts.en: I have a point of view I want to write up and adapt for several platforms. Take it from draft to platform-ready — drafts only, I will hit publish myself.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有个观点想写成文章并分发到几个平台，帮我从草稿做到各平台可发状态；只建草稿，我自己点发布。

quickPrompts.en: Generate a cover image and summary cards for this article.
quickPrompts.zh: 给这篇文章生成封面图和小结卡片。
